_label: SAMPLE — illustrative, not official. Codes use the SAMPLE- prefix and are NOT WHO ICD-11 codes. Biomedical links marked who-index are illustrative stand-ins for WHO-published linkages.

entities.title: Traditional medicine conditions – Module 2
entities.definition: SAMPLE root of the Traditional Medicine Module 2 hierarchy.

entities.title: Ama-vata joint disorder
entities.definition: Joint disorder in which ama and vitiated vata lodge in the joints, causing pain, swelling and stiffness.

entities.title: Degenerative joint disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Vata disorder of the joints with pain on movement, crepitus and reduced range of motion.

entities.title: Vata-rakta disorder
entities.definition: Disorder of vata and rakta beginning in the small joints of the feet, with burning pain and swelling.

entities.title: Radiating leg pain disorder
entities.definition: Pain radiating from the buttock down the back of the leg, with stiffness.

entities.title: Lumbar pain disorder
entities.definition: Pain and stiffness in the lumbar region.

entities.title: Neck stiffness disorder
entities.definition: Stiffness of the neck with restricted movement.

entities.title: Hemiplegia disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Loss of motor function of one side of the body.

entities.title: Facial deviation disorder
entities.definition: Deviation of one half of the face with difficulty in closing the eye.

entities.title: Seizure disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Recurrent episodes of loss of consciousness with abnormal body movements.

entities.title: Sour-bile disorder
entities.definition: Disorder of increased sour pitta with heartburn, sour eructation and nausea.

entities.title: Grahani disorder
entities.definition: Disorder of weak digestive fire with irregular bowel habit, alternating loose and hard stools.

entities.title: Diarrhoea disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Frequent passage of loose stools.

entities.title: Haemorrhoid disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Mass in the anal canal obstructing defaecation, sometimes bleeding.

entities.title: Indigestion disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Food is not properly digested, with heaviness and belching.

entities.title: Vomiting disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Forceful expulsion of stomach contents through the mouth.

entities.title: Abdominal distension disorder
entities.definition: Distension of the abdomen with retention of faeces and flatus.

entities.title: Worm infestation disorder
entities.definition: Infestation of the bowel by worms.

entities.title: Constipation disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Infrequent or difficult passage of hard stools.

entities.title: Cough disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Forceful expulsion of air from the respiratory passage with a characteristic sound.

entities.title: Breathlessness disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Difficult or laboured breathing.

entities.title: Wheezing breathlessness disorder
entities.definition: Episodic breathlessness with wheeze, aggravated at night and by cold.

entities.title: Nasal catarrh disorder
entities.definition: Nasal discharge with sneezing and heaviness of the head.

entities.title: Hiccup disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Repeated involuntary hiccups.

entities.title: Consumptive wasting disorder
entities.definition: Progressive depletion of body tissues with cough and weakness.

entities.title: Painful urination disorder
entities.definition: Difficult and painful passage of urine.

entities.title: Urinary stone disorder
entities.definition: Formation of stones in the urinary tract.

entities.title: Urinary retention disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Obstruction to the outflow of urine.

entities.title: Scaly skin disorder
entities.definition: Large dry patches of skin with scales resembling those of a fish.

entities.title: Itchy weeping skin disorder
entities.definition: Itchy eruption with oozing and dark discolouration.

entities.title: White patch skin disorder
entities.definition: White depigmented patches of skin.

entities.title: Wheal disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Sudden itchy wheals on the skin.

entities.title: Spreading skin inflammation disorder
entities.definition: Rapidly spreading inflammation of the skin.

entities.title: Pallor disorder
entities.definition: Pallor of the body with weakness and breathlessness on exertion.

entities.title: Jaundice disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Yellow discolouration of the eyes, skin and urine.

entities.title: Bleeding disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Bleeding from the body orifices due to vitiated pitta.

entities.title: Oedema disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Swelling of a part or the whole of the body.

entities.title: Mental derangement disorder
entities.definition: Derangement of mind, intellect, memory and conduct.

entities.title: Sleeplessness disorder
entities.definition: Difficulty in initiating or maintaining sleep.

entities.title: Dizziness disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Sensation of whirling and unsteadiness.

entities.title: Painful menstruation disorder
entities.definition: Pain during menstruation.

entities.title: White vaginal discharge disorder
entities.definition: Abnormal white discharge per vaginum.

entities.title: Excessive menstrual bleeding disorder
entities.definition: Excessive or prolonged menstrual bleeding.

entities.title: Fever disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Raised body temperature with discomfort of body and mind.

entities.title: Prameha disorder
entities.definition: Group of disorders with excessive and turbid urination.

entities.title: Sweet urine disorder
entities.definition: Prameha in which the urine is sweet like honey.

entities.title: Obesity disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Excessive accumulation of fat in the body.

entities.title: Neck swelling disorder
entities.definition: Swelling in the front of the neck.

entities.title: Headache disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Pain in the head.

entities.title: Hemicrania disorder
entities.definition: Paroxysmal pain in one half of the head.

entities.title: Toothache disorder (TM2)
entities.definition: Pain in the teeth.

entities.title: Vata pattern (TM2)
entities.definition: Pattern of increased vata with dryness, roughness, pain and constipation.

entities.title: Pitta pattern (TM2)
entities.definition: Pattern of increased pitta with burning, thirst and yellowish discolouration.

entities.title: Kapha pattern (TM2)
entities.definition: Pattern of increased kapha with heaviness, lethargy and excess mucus.

entities.title: Vata-pitta pattern (TM2)
entities.definition: Combined pattern of increased vata and pitta.

entities.title: Ama pattern (TM2)
entities.definition: Pattern in which the doshas are associated with ama, with heaviness, coated tongue and anorexia.

entities.title: Diminished agni pattern
entities.definition: Pattern of weak digestive fire with poor appetite and slow digestion.
